bundle.name: Every Buddy
bundle.blurb: Unlock every buddy, including the ones we add later.

items.name: Kai
items.blurb: Easygoing and upbeat. Walks in, tells you straight, cheers when you finish.

items.name: Mira
items.blurb: Calm and organised. Keeps your day moving without the noise.

items.name: Bolt
items.blurb: A calm white robot that hovers in with glowing eyes.

items.name: Miso
items.blurb: A ginger cat who will absolutely judge you for skipping things.

items.name: Pip
items.blurb: Waddles in, flaps, and keeps you on schedule.

items.name: Boo
items.blurb: Floats in quietly. Haunts you only a little.

items.name: Mochi
items.blurb: A wobbly see-through jelly with a lot of enthusiasm.

items.name: Quackers
items.blurb: A glossy rubber duck. Squeaky, punctual.
